title: Board Force Graph Layout With Dimforge
description: Add force-directed graph layout for the elements board: WASM/TS tool with configurable options, using nalgebra (dimforge) for 2D vector math in Rust. Wire into board play UI as a toolbar action. Extend existing board tests.
summary: Fixed dev board crash: @elements/ui Label is the property-row inspector component (required string id, uses id.split in useMemo). Force-layout toolbar fields incorrectly used Label with htmlFor only, so id was undefined. Swapped those three controls to native HTML label + htmlFor.
